# W: ground walls by the design's outer-wall rule (tools/vrmaps/Walls.cs): interior -> both sides, step -> its low side only, outer -> toward the play area only, ledge -> 'low'; checked with rays (a face no view sees is not added; a game face still seen is kept); inner -> a wall seen from the walkable side it is missing from (the design's inner walls)
# T: a void-filler top under a walkable cell, drawn; F: a seen hole beside the walkable floor on a map without its own sky, filled black
